description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Strategy_FixNesting, which implements a strategy for fixing the nesting of HTML tokens to ensure they conform to HTML specifications. It includes methods for processing tokens, building a tree structure, validating children, and removing or reorganizing nodes as needed.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Strategy_FixNesting
classes.description: A class that implements a strategy to fix the nesting of HTML tokens, ensuring they conform to HTML element nesting rules.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method that processes a list of tokens to fix their nesting according to HTML rules, using a non-recursive post-order traversal.
